content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the intellectual property clause, the text currently assigns these rights instantly upon creation rather than upon final payment, and I propose to amend the clause to state that intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the deliverables. - Regarding the relevant clause on invoicing, the milestone amounts combined with the initial deposit create mathematical inconsistencies, and I propose to revise the milestone and deposit figures so that their sum precisely matches the total estimated project fee of USD 24,875. Thank you and best regards.
